content:
Starting balance — Supplier — Edit

When you begin using Manager.io, it's important to enter any existing balances you have with your suppliers. The Starting Balance - Supplier Edit form is where you can set up these starting balances to accurately reflect amounts owed to your suppliers.

Supplier Selection

In the form, select the supplier from the list of suppliers you've already created under the Suppliers tab. This ensures that the starting balance is correctly associated with the right supplier account.

Configuring Starting Balances

Under the Lines section of the form, you can input the details of your starting balances. This involves specifying the amounts that represent what you owe to the supplier at the start date of your records in Manager.io.

Important Note: If there are any unpaid or partially unpaid invoices from a supplier, you should enter each of these invoices individually under the Purchase Invoices tab. Recording them separately allows for precise tracking of payments and outstanding amounts for each invoice.
